name: Matthias Heinrich
headline: Co-Founder & CPO @ Plato | Building the AI Operating System for Wholesale Distribution | We’re hiring!
summary:
Co-Founder & CPO at Plato - we're building the AI operating system for wholesale distribution. Join us, we're hiring!



The $50 trillion+ wholesale distribution industry runs on outdated software, manual processes, and fragmented data. We're changing that. Plato connects CRM, ERP, and sales intelligence into a single AI-powered platform that learns from every customer interaction and makes wholesale sales teams 10x more productive.



We've raised $20M+ from leading investors and work with some of Europe’s largest distribution businesses - from plumbing and electrical suppliers to industrial wholesalers.



Before Plato, I launched new ventures at Rocket Internet and worked in early-stage startups. I have a background in management and computer science from TU Munich, CDTM, and WHU.



My focus: AI-powered B2B workflows, vertical AI and SaaS, sales intelligence platforms, and building products for industries ready for transformation. Always happy to connect with founders, product leaders, and investors working on similar challenges.

company.name: Plato
company.tagline: Wir bauen die Zukunft des Großhandels.
company.description:
Plato (DM Technologies GmbH) ist die ganzheitliche Wachstumsplattform für den Großhandel. Wir erhöhen Umsätze durch KI-Analysen wie Up- & Cross-Selling und senken Kosten durch Prozessautomatisierungen verbunden mit tiefer ERP-Integration.

Bei Plato kommen wir selbst aus dem Großhandel, denken wie Familienunternehmer und entwickeln ein Produkt Hand in Hand mit unseren Kunden, um den B2B-Handel für die nächste Generation stark aufzustellen.
